Car Parking at Lee Valley Ice Centre
How many parking spaces are available?
There are 155 car parking spaces available for customers, including 32 electric vehicle charging points and 16 blue badge bays.
Is there a charge to park?
Venue users using the facilities including gym, fitness classes and ice rinks are entitled to up to four hours free car parking.
Customers using the venue must enter their vehicle registration details on arrival in the terminal in the reception area to get free parking for up to four hours.
Can I stay for longer than four hours?
If you plan to stay beyond the free four hour period, customers must pay for additional time using the Evology parking app.
How to pay:
-    Download the Evology parking app from the App Store or Google Play
-    Open the app and select “pay to park”
-    Enter Location ID: 809102
-    Choose your duration and complete payment
For more information, visit: www.evologyparking.com
If I’m not using the facilities but just visiting, do I still get free parking?
General visitors to the area using the car park can receive up to two hours free parking when they spend a minimum of £5 in the venue café.
Can I use the car park if attending an event?
At Lee Valley Ice Centre, please note there is no car parking for ticketed events. This is not a decision made by the venue; it’s one of the conditions of the planning permission which was granted for the venue to be built which must be strictly followed.
We encourage visitors to travel to the venue using public transport. There’s a bus stop right outside, and Lea Bridge and Clapton stations are short walks away.
If you do wish to drive, you must not park in any local roads, but you can park at Westfield Stratford City and catch a train, Lea Bridge is one stop from Stratford, bus or walk to the venue.
Can I park in the electric vehicle bays?
EV bays are for electric vehicles only, whilst actively charging. Vehicles not charging or non-electric vehicles parked in these bays may receive a Parking Charge Notice (PCN)
How do I appeal a Parking Charge Notice (PCN)?
The car park is managed by Parking Eye. For information on appealing a PCN, please visit the ParkingEye website directly. Please note: The venue is unable to cancel or amend Parking Charge Notices.
